titulo: Gap (Apr 2023): $222 million in dividends, about 1,800 jobs planned cuts. The math.
caption:
From the archive: Apr 2023. Not today's news.
Gap, Apr 27, 2023 (The Gap, Inc., Form 8-K): "to further simplify and optimize its operating model and structure"
Gap said in an SEC filing on April 27, 2023 that it planned to reduce its headquarters and upper field workforce by approximately 1,800 employees. The dividend figure is from its Form 10-K.

Same fiscal year: $222 million in dividends, fiscal 2023, company-wide. $222 million of dividends declared and paid in fiscal 2023, company-wide (Form 10-K, table in millions).
The math: $222 million in dividends (2023) ÷ about 1,800 job cuts = about $123,333 in dividends per planned job cut.
This is a ratio, not a payment and not a cause: the dividends paid divided by the job count. The $222 million is the dividends Gap declared and paid in fiscal 2023 (February 2023 to February 2024), company-wide; it is not buybacks. The 1,800 are headquarters and upper field employees, not the whole company. We are not saying one paid for the other.

Simplified and optimized. Here is the dividend column. (Our take.)

For someone whose company once set out to simplify and optimize.

Sources: SEC EDGAR · Gap Inc., Apr 27, 2023; SEC EDGAR · Gap Inc., Mar 19, 2024.
